name: See Georgia: Cloudland Canyon B 2025

venue.name: Cloudland Canyon State Park
venue.address: 122 Cloudland Canyon Park Rd, Rising Fawn, GA 30738

information:
We are bringing cubing back to beautiful Cloudland Canyon for the **first ever competitions supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)**! Please check out the Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)

Entering and parking at Cloudland Canyon State Park costs **$5 per vehicle per day** for anyone without a Georgia State Parks parking pass, so please review the Venue and Travel tab before registering to ensure you have a plan to travel to and access the park.
